falsifier_requirement.trigger: FDC source snapshot hash is missing or changes during replay; nutrient number 307 appears in visible model or comparator inputs; visible ash nutrient 207 or calcium nutrient 301 is missing; N is below 20; target-hidden task table, hidden target lock, scoring pack, or replay hash is missing or changes during replay; sodium shuffle negative control is not rejected

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: predict sodium_mg_per_100g = max(0, 393.37 * visible_ash_g_per_100g), using the sodium mass fraction of sodium chloride as a fixed visible-ash proxy; nutrient 307 is excluded from visible inputs and is unsealed only for scoring

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: FoodData Central visible calcium mineral baseline
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: predict sodium_mg_per_100g = visible calcium_mg_per_100g from nutrient 301
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Inspect the existing scorer output, repair the OC model/comparator/residual/materiality implementation, and preserve negative results if OC does not beat the comparator.

residual_requirement.formula: absolute sodium residual in mg per 100 g; aggregate MAE across heldout FDC food rows
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_MAE must beat comparator_MAE by a material predeclared margin and every negative control must be rejected; this work order does not permit coverage closure from the compact scorer alone

target_variable.extraction_rule: Target values remain hidden until scoring according to the domain-local work order.
target_variable.name: heldout_food_sodium_content

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute sodium residual in mg per 100 g; aggregate MAE across heldout FDC food rows
uncertainty_requirement.rule: deterministic jackknife interval over row-level absolute sodium residuals after prediction materialization

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
